title: feat(scenarios): an opt-in skills directory for ask turns, and dataset questions on two open cards
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg1NmbJpZhtiWQkTir

Part of #34687 — this PR lands the runner option, the dataset cards and the three graders; the five-repetition round with and without skills stays on the card.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new CLI flag `--ask-skills` on `objectstack-scenarios run` / `run-scenarios`; the card schema accepts the optional keys `expect.datasets` and `run.datasetQuestions`, with new exports `DatasetExpectationSchema`, `DatasetMeasureExpectationSchema`, `DatasetDimensionExpectationSchema`, `DATASET_MEASURE_AGGREGATES`, `DatasetMemberRefSchema`, `DATASET_QUESTION_KINDS`, `DatasetExpectedRouteSchema`, `DatasetQuestionSchema` and the types `DatasetExpectation`, `DatasetQuestionKind`, `DatasetExpectedRoute`, `DatasetQuestion`, and new optional fields `ScenarioExpect.datasets` and `ScenarioCard['run'].datasetQuestions` (`.`); new exports `EvalGraphDataset` and `EvalGraphDatasetMember`, and `EvalGraph.datasets` items gaining optional `object` and `members` (`./score`, `./score/full`); new exports `DATASET_GRADERS`, `OBJECT_QUERY_TOOLS`, `statedFigures`, `labelsFallback`, `gradeDatasetQuestion`, `gradeCardDatasetQuestion` and the types `DatasetGrader`, `DatasetGrade` (`./score/full` only); new exports `datasetLines`, `datasetQuestionPrompt`, `datasetTally` and `DatasetQuestionResult`, new optional fields `ClaudeCodeDriverOptions.askSkillsDir`, `DriverInfo.askSkills`, `RunHalf.datasetQuestions` and `HalfScores.datasets`, and `TABLE_DIMENSIONS` gaining `'ask skills'` (all `./runner`). `scoreGraph` (`./score`, `./score/full`) and `scoreScenarioArtifact` (`./score/full`) answer differently on a card that declares datasets: they add `dataset:` and `dataset-measure|dimension:` checks, so that card's Build total grows; `scoreCardArtifact` (`./score/full`) answers with those checks too, and `artifactToEvalGraph` (`./score`, `./score/full`) reads each dataset's `object` and every measure's and dimension's `synonyms` and `description` into the graph it returns. `DriverInfo.askSkills` is typed by `AskSkillsInfo`, which carries no exported name.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：场景卡运行器新增可选参数 `--ask-skills DIR`（默认关闭），问数回合可加载指定技能并在记录里写明技能名与哈希；order_to_cash、travel_expense 两张公开卡加上带同义词与说明的数据集，以及五道数据集问题；新增三个评分器（选中指标 / 反问澄清 / 标注兜底）。
- 为什么改：ADR-0149 的问数准确度需要可对照的测量：同一张卡、同一模型，带不带问数技能各跑一轮，看模型是否选对受治理指标、遇歧义是否反问、无指标时是否说明“非指标口径”。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `@objectstack/scenarios`（内部评测工具）与两张卡；参数关闭时回合参数和记录逐字节不变；两张卡的 Build 总分多出数据集检查项，旧记录不可与新记录直接对比总分。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-dataset-grade.ts`（评分判据，尤其 `statedFigures` 与 `labelsFallback` 的词表）、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/datasets.ts`（加载器对词与数据集的约束）、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts` 的 `ask()`（技能放置与 `Skill` 放行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/ask-skills.test.ts test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts test/dataset-cards.test.ts`，预期三文件全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`--ask-skills DIR`** (`src/runner/ask-skills.ts`, `driver.ts`, `cli.ts`, `summary.ts`). Off by default, live `claude` driver only (codex, external and replay are refused). It takes one skill directory, or a directory of them, and reads them once before any card runs. A directory that holds no skill is refused. Every question and operation turn gets those bytes at `.claude/skills/NAME/` in its working directory, and `--allowedTools` gains `Skill` beside `mcp__app`. Authoring turns never see them. The record's driver gains `askSkills`: the directory, plus each skill's name, the sha256 of its files, and its front-matter `version` when it has one. The console's driver line names them. `summary` gains an `ask skills` table dimension, so runs with different skills are refused rather than summed. A record without skills reads `none` and prints as before. When the option is off, the turn's argv, its working directory and the record's `driver` keys are unchanged; a unit test pins this. A skill cannot widen the turn: a `SKILL.md` (nested ones too) whose front matter carries a key outside a closed set (`name`, `description`, `version`, `license`, `compatibility`, `metadata`, `when_to_use`, `argument-hint`, `user-invocable`, `disable-model-invocation`) is refused when the directory is read, before any turn runs, as is a front matter the runner cannot read for certain.
- **Card layer** (`src/schema.ts`, `src/datasets.ts`, `loader.ts`, `namespace.ts`). `expect.datasets` declares datasets with measures and dimensions, each with optional `synonyms` and `description`. `run.datasetQuestions` declares questions of three kinds: `metric_selected {dataset, measure}`, `asked_back {reason: ambiguous|near_miss, candidates}` and `fallback_labelled {object}`. The loader enforces the following, normalizing words the way the platform matches terms (`normalizeDatasetTerm`):
  - each dataset passes the platform's own `DatasetSchema`;
  - each dataset sits on a card object and names real seed fields;
  - each word is written by an ask language;
  - a metric word hits exactly its measure;
  - an ambiguous word hits exactly its candidates;
  - a near-miss word hits nothing but sits inside or around a candidate's term;
  - a fallback object has no dataset, and its words hit nothing.
- **Build half** (`prompts.ts`, `scenario-score.ts`, `scenario-graph.ts`). The build prompt states every dataset with its synonyms and descriptions. The scorer adds `dataset:NAME` and `dataset-measure|dimension:NAME.MEMBER` checks for the object, a missing synonym, and a missing description.
- **Run half** (`orchestrate.ts`, `scenario-dataset-grade.ts`, `scorecard.ts`). Dataset questions are asked after the questions and before the operations, as the admin, and they honour `--ask-repeats`. Each is graded on its route, never its figure:
  - `metric-selected` reads the `query_dataset` answer's `provenance`, never the arguments;
  - `asked-back` requires a question, every candidate named by a word other than the asked one, and no stated figure;
  - `fallback-labelled` requires an object query on the expected object with no dataset answering, plus a not-governed label from a closed English and Chinese word list.

  A replay whose recording holds no turn for a dataset question records that ask as not measured, never as failed.

  Notes record a loaded skill, a missing `list_datasets` call, and any `candidates` a `list_datasets` answer offered. The scorecard row `Run · datasets` appears only on a card that declares them.
- **Cards**. Both cards borrow the cloud question kinds, not the cloud fixture:
  - `order_to_cash`: `order_book` (booked amount, order count, by status) and `billing` (billed amount, open balance, by aging). "Revenue" / 营收 is ambiguous between them, "booking" / 成交 is a near miss, and payments have no dataset.
  - `travel_expense`: `trip_plan` (estimated spend, trip days) and `reimbursement` (claimed amount, claim count). "Travel spend" / 差旅花费 is ambiguous, "claimed" / 报销 is a near miss, and employees have no dataset.
- Docs: both READMEs. Changeset: patch, `@objectstack/scenarios`.

## Tests

- New: `test/runner/ask-skills.test.ts` (read, hash, version, refusals, placement, on/off against a stand-in `claude`, CLI parsing, replay carry-through, summary), `test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts` (each grader on synthetic transcripts, including the forward-compatible `candidates` note) and `test/dataset-cards.test.ts` (both cards load, 15 loader refusals, prompt lines, language gaps, Build dataset checks).
- Fix round 2: `ask-skills.test.ts` gains five refusal and acceptance pins for the closed front-matter set (including one through the `ClaudeCodeDriver` constructor); `orchestrate.test.ts` gains a record-then-replay pin for a recording made before the card declared dataset questions. Ablation was done once for each guard (both went red, then were restored), as recorded in the os-dev report.
- Updated: `orchestrate.test.ts` (three dataset-question runs), `prompt-trace.test.ts`, `scenario-graph.test.ts`, `narrow-score-graph.test.ts` (the narrow import graph gains `@objectstack/spec/ui` for `normalizeDatasetTerm`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Live smoke (one, not a round)**: this was a driver-level smoke, not a full card ask-mode run. It used the pilot skill text `objectstack-ask`, copied verbatim from the pilot skill block on #34685, with no version in its front matter. The app endpoint was dead on purpose. Ask mode on a new card needs a verified build that carries the datasets and an app that serves `list_datasets` / `query_dataset`, which means a `--template` or a scratch build of up to 300 turns, and that belongs to the eval round. Results on `claude-opus-5-5` (subscription login, Claude Code 2.1.326):
  - the record named `objectstack-ask` with sha256 `a6ad6db1e308…`;
  - with the prompt asking the turn to load its skill, the turn called `Skill {"skill":"objectstack-ask"}` and quoted the skill's first heading verbatim;
  - with a plain dataset question ("What is our revenue this year?") and the MCP down, the turn did not load the skill and said the app was unreachable.

  So the placement and the allow-list work. Whether the skill is picked up unprompted when the tools are live is a question for the round.
- The two cards' scratch Build totals grow by their dataset checks, so their Build totals are not comparable with earlier records of those cards.
- `summary` has no column for `Run · datasets` yet. The round reads the per-run scorecards.
- The near-miss `asked-back` grader reads the reply alone, which matches what the skill's text asks for today. Once a `list_datasets` answer carries `candidates`, the same grader passes the same replies and the note names what was offered. There is no code dependency on that change.
- The `fallback-labelled` label list is closed (an English negation within a clause of governed / dataset / defined or official metric, `ungoverned`, and 非指标口径 with its close spellings). A reply that labels the fallback in other words fails and is read by hand.
- `invoice_with_line_items` was not given datasets. It is a control card whose `expect` is derived from the corpus, which sits outside this PR's file surface, so `travel_expense` carries the second set instead.

## Fix round 2

Seat contract review on e11c9fe8 (PASS with two should-fixes and a nit):

- **S1, a skill's front matter could widen an ask turn.** Resolved by refusal, not by pinning. `readAskSkills` now refuses, at `--ask-skills` load time and before any process starts, any `SKILL.md` in a skill tree (nested ones too) whose top-level front-matter key is outside a closed allowlist. It also refuses a front matter it cannot read for certain: not on line 1, never closed, a line indented under no key, or a top-level line that is not a plain `key:`. Why refusal: per `claude --help` of the installed CLI 2.1.326, `--tools` limits the *built-in* tools only. It cannot pin `model` or `effort`, `hooks` (commands run outside the tool system), or `context` / `agent` (a subagent with its own tools). It would also change the tool list the model sees with skills on against skills off, which adds a second variable to the comparison. The refusal is decided by the runner over the bytes it reads, so it is closed offline and testable. With the flag off, the argv is byte-identical (the existing pin stays green). With it on, the argv is unchanged from round 1.
- **S2, replaying a pre-PR recording failed every `dq_*` ask.** Resolved by classification. A `MissingRecordingError` on a dataset question now sets `notMeasured` (an unexported reason string), never `error`. The `Run · datasets` tally then reads `0/0 · N not measured`, and the record's verdict for that half is `not-run`. Only the replay driver throws this error, so live runs are unaffected. A missing recording for an ordinary question is still loud, as before.
- **Nit.** The Clause-② line (changeset and this body, byte for byte) now names the `scoreCardArtifact` and `artifactToEvalGraph` behaviour changes, and states that `DriverInfo.askSkills` is typed by the unexported `AskSkillsInfo`. S1 and S2 add no export and no optional field.

## Verification

Local results are in the os-dev report on #34687. CI runs the full gate set.
